exception.justification: Justified: Immutable field access inherits the operation that constructed the disclosure; it performs no verification.

review.item_premise: Only named public, untrusted authentication disclosures enter. Presence checks retain bytes and edition strings without interpreting them, admitting a cryptographic edition, or authenticating a signature, header, seal or approval. Trace may retain these public disclosures; no key generation, secret custody, codec or publication effect enters this body.
